offers_products.reason: Manufactures credit, debit and prepaid cards, plus SaaS instant issuance (Card@Once) and push provisioning software.

offers_services.reason: Card personalization, fulfillment, and fraud tools services (Rippleshot) for banks; services are a significant part alongside card production.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are banks, credit unions, fintechs and prepaid program managers; cardholders are end users, not buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells cards and issuance platforms to banks, credit unions, fintechs, processors and retailers of prepaid cards.

recurring_revenue.reason: Banks reorder cards for reissues and new accounts continually; repeat card orders, fulfillment and SaaS fees from the same issuers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Card reissuance and replacement by banks are ongoing and non-discretionary, though new-account volume and prepaid vary somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Cards are low-cost items ordered frequently in volume; fulfillment and subscriptions are small, recurring purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured cards and technology platform, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are banks, large issuers, processors and prepaid program managers, though many are regional banks and credit unions.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs card production plants, but the manufacturing is moderately capital-light compared with heavy industry; technology-led platform.

notes: Large-customer and asset-heavy answers are judgment calls; customers mix large banks with small credit unions.
